## Usage

- **Source IMEI** — the real field device to fetch historical telemetry from
- **Mock IMEI** — the provisioned mock device to simulate/upload data into
- **Mock Vehicle ID** — the pre-created vehicle record on the platform tied to the mock IMEI
- Data is also available as `window.TEST_FLEET` via `frontend/test-fleet.js`
